## Summary
Paper: [arXiv:2609.31603](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31603) - "Belief Self-Distillation: A Unified Read-Write Framework for LLM Beliefs About Users"

**Key contribution**: Bridges linear probing (accurate but shallow) and causal intervention (causal but coarse) by distilling linear belief probes into directional read vectors. Achieves 18.3 percentage point improvement over baselines for belief extraction across GPT-6 and Llama 4.3 models.

## Why it fits interplay-adversarial

**Direct alignment**: BSD enables measuring what models infer about users (demographic attributes, education level, etc.) and how those beliefs drive behavioral changes. This is exactly what cultural bias evaluation needs - not just detecting biased outputs, but understanding the belief formation that drives them.

**Gap addressed**: Current interplay probes test for output bias but don't measure:
- Internal belief formation about user attributes
- How beliefs translate to differential treatment
- Causal relationships between inferred attributes and output changes

## Potential integration

- [ ] **Novel capability**: Add belief-auditing layer to cultural bias probes
- [ ] **Complements existing**: BSD would sit between probe generation and judge scoring - measuring the "why" behind biased outputs
- [ ] **Addresses gap**: No current capability for internal state auditing of models
